titles.native: NARUTO -ナルト- 疾風伝 疾風! "木ノ葉学園"伝

description:
A black & white picture drama about an alternate universe. Naruto and the gang go to a "normal" high school and Naruto is a new transfer student. His ambition is becoming a "souban."

Note: Sold with limited edition of Naruto Shippuuden DVD 7.
